t: Kill 6 Wretched Vampires on the Eastern Horn island. Report back to Milvus in the Historians' Camp.

Usually we'd get assistance from the Historians' mercenaries... Seven magnificent Orcs! But all seven died a valiant and beautiful death! But now we have no one else to count on but you!
I beg of you, please hurry over to the Eastern Horn and help the aviaks defend their village against the vampires. Kill no less than ten of them. We must halt their wicked invasion!
Did you deal with the vampires? Will they stay away from our village from now on?

Now my tribe can sleep peacefully.
Thank you, I don't know what we would have done without you!

The vampires have amplified the destructive force of their beam to the point where Zayan is barely able to hold it off!
A long time ago, when Zayan first formed an alliance with the aviaks, he bestowed upon them a gift - an ancient Elven artifact that grants its owner great power and might.
Zayan himself could sure use that artifact right about now... We must ask the aviaks to lend us the Artifact of Power.
Go to their village and speak with their elder. Surely, he'll understand why we need it!

We have guarded Zayan's gift with the utmost veneration and are ready to return it at his command!
However, it's not here in the village. When Great Mage Zayan formed an alliance with the aviaks, we have erected a monument to commemorate the event. The Artifact of Power is atop the monument. In those times, our land knew only peace and prosperity, vampires were only a thing of myth and legend.
Collect the Artifact of Power, kill Screechwing, and speak to Zayan de Desirae.

The monument was erected in the northern region of the Eastern Horn. Of course, had I known that the area would come to be occupied by those blasted vampires, I would have picked a different spot!
You will need to pass through the woods. It's teeming with those beasts and their loyal minions, the bats. So watch out for both. One of our scouts went ahead and reported that the monument is being guarded by a huge bat. You will need to kill it, take the artifact, and hurry back to Zayan. All our hopes rest on him... And on you as well!
Without the artifact, I won't be able to repel the beam for much longer as the vampires keep amplifying its force. And if my magic shield is breached, we will all perish!

You have my utmost gratitude! You've come just in time - I'm barely holding on! The Historians have informed me of all the miseries that have transpired on other allods. I also know that a weapon of such terrible power has never been used before.
The beam appears to be a vampire invention. They're testing it on my allod, and when they destroy it, they'll move on to the rest! I cannot stop them, but with the help of this artifact I can hold them off a while longer!
Kill 6 Dusky Bats on Eastern Horn and return to Corvus.

The vampires treat these bats like pets – they feed them and look after them. That's why there have been so many of them around here lately!
It's gotten to the point where they invade our homes in the trees and build their nests in our territory! They think they've got it made, but we won't stand for it! Please drive those bats out of our homes! Make sure that they're dead, or they'll just come back later.
Those bats bite hard! Who knows what kinds of diseases they're carrying! We need to get them out of our homes before they're completely ruined.
Thanks for saving our homes! Those bats are nothing but trouble. If we didn't get rid of them, we would surely lose our aerial superiority!
Use the Signal Whistle in the centers of the Astral Fangs to summon an Aviak Watcher and Vincent de Doucer, Gerard de Doucer, and Gabriel de Doucer. Slay the vampire leaders and return to Corvus.

We value your bravery and valor and that is why we want to offer you a role in an honorary hunt on the Eastern Horn.
Our scouts report sighting three new vampires issuing commands to their kind and conversing with the demons. Demons are way too arrogant to talk to a common vampire... These three are without a doubt their tribe's elite!
Liquidating them won't be easy, but I have faith in you.
Our scout will track down the vampire and attack it. Join in the fight and together you will defeat the enemy!
Three vampires, three friends bound by blood! Were you and my scout successful in destroying them? Or will I need to look for someone else to do the job?

All three are dead? Good riddance! I wonder what position they held in the vampire hierarchy. Then again, that doesn't matter now. The important thing is that the vampire leadership has been beheaded.
I'd like to see how they react to this loss! Everyone knows that seasoned commanders are the key to any victory. Just think - would the Aviaks have been able to repel the enemy so well if I wasn't at the helm? Didn't think so!
Speak to Milvus at the Historians' Camp.

With your help, we were able to thin the vampires' numbers and drive away the bats, though I fear that these are but temporary measures.
The stream of vampires and demons to the allod remains undisturbed and that means that we'll be forced to defend ourselves once more soon enough. Not to mention their wretched beam that's threatening to destroy the entire allod, then...
And then we will all perish in the Astral! This problem can only be solved at the root. I shall send my scouts to the ship, and I want you to tell Milvus to wait for their report.

So Corvus finally decided to send reinforcements? I know that he's always extremely cautious and shies away from needless risks, but here we must act quickly and decisively. Were it up to me, I'd have gathered up all the Aviaks and hit Darkblood Citadel with all our might! I'd rather go down fighting than sit and wait for the vampires' beam to destroy Avilon!
Use the Battleworn Artifact to activate a June golem at the Western Horn.

Let's turn our attention to the artifact that you recovered from the ruins in the Totnum Forest. We must test it! The Western Horn is home to another set of June ruins, and I believe they hold a number of intact golems.
I've mentioned this to Zayan plenty of times, thinking that the golems would make excellent fighters and assistants, but up until now we didn't know how to activate them!
Head over there and try to activate at least one golem using the artifact. I just know it'll work! I'll be here, praying for your success!
This golem looks like it's charged up, while all the others are in a dormant state. You should try using the artifact and see what happens!

You carefully place the artifact into a small slot in the golem. Hopefully it won't attack you... who knows what its creators programmed it to do! It looks like it wants to say something, but you cannot understand its language.
Collect any information you can on the wormfaces for Luc de Blizare.

I can't stop thinking about that dead wormface we found along the northern shore.
We have to find out where it came from and whether there are others like it on our allod. If so, where are they hiding and what are we to expect from them?! We must find the answers to these questions!
Our scouts found a dead demon at the June ruins on the Western Horn. It could be that it was slain by these creatures. That's the one theory that makes sense, anyway. Go over there and check out the situation - maybe you'll luck out and run into a live wormface!
What are these strange creatures with detestable faces? Was it nature that created them or someone's twisted imagination?! Could they be a kind of Astral mutant? What did you find out?

It seems that the wormfaced creatures awoken from their sleep when the vampire ship began to destroy the allod. Imagine how long they've been sleeping in the ground if even the June knew nothing of their existence!
It's unfortunate that we don't have any answers to our questions. I also find it curious that it was the golems that helped us to learn more about the Wormfaces! Truly, these golems are wondrous machines - the Historians sure could have used them during excavation works.
There I go again, forgetting that the faction has been disbanded. We better start thinking about saving the allod and our lives along with it!
Control a June Golem to try to communicate with Vir-Gar.

You wonder what this squeaking, clinking, and banging could mean. You need to figure out a way to speak with the golem. It appears that the nearby golems have become activated - perhaps using one of them would help.
Greetings. It is time to resume our tasks.
Kill 6 Spiteful Predators on Western Horn and report back to Vir-Gar on the Dark Shards.

Running system diagnostics...
Warning! Malfunction detected! Rebooting. Memory loaded, checking database. Check complete. Scanning area. Multiple Curses detected. Curses are weak but may pose a threat to the Creators.
Objective: eliminate six Curses. Commence mission immediately.
Sending mission update request to subordinate machine. Awaiting update. Curse eliminated?
Subordinate machine reports that Curses have been destroyed. Verifying against control mission... Verification complete. Subordinate machine has completed mission. Curses are destroyed.

A Creator must be present for further operation. Systems may malfunction without a Creator. Vir-Gar machine commencing biological analysis... No Creator found. Analyzing local terrain... Creators not present.
According to instructions, commencing independent biological analysis. Error... Must replace power supply to resume analysis. Subordinate machine must supply Vir-Gar with three batteries! Suggestion - check surrounding location.
Biological analysis impossible. Power supply must be replaced.
Batteries accepted. Commencing biological analysis. Analysis conducted in background mode and may take some time.
Bring a Wormface Corpse to Vir-Gar.

New life form discovered. Verifying against data base. Verification complete. No matches found. Sample of creature needed for detailed study. Subordinate machine must supply Vir-Gar with one specimen of wormfaced creature. In case of resistance, use of force authorized. Trampling and mutilating creature is not authorized.
Subordinate machine is assigned mission to deliver unknown creature for analysis. Vir-Gar machine awaiting sample.

Analysis to begin in ten seconds. Bone structure analysis complete. Skin analysis complete. Internal organ, nervous system, sensory organ analysis complete. Analyzing reproductive system. Standby. Final analysis complete.
Kill 6 Wormfaces and report back to Vir-Gar.

Specimen analysis complete.
Unknown creature, no match in database. Creature is aggressive with well-developed brain. Potential threat level: eight.
Suggestion: destroy six specimens to ensure safety of the Creators. Eliminate the targets.
Safety of Creators potentially threatened. Subordinate machine must liquidate wormfaced creatures. Awaiting report.

Received report on destruction of wormfaced creatures. Subordinate machine has completed mission. Report will be made to the Creators upon discovery. Resuming biological analysis. Creators not found. Continuing search - standby...
Drill in 6 mounds of Strange Soil and report the results to Vir-Gar.

Soil particles discovered under creatures' claws. Theory - creature resides underground. Suggestion - check accessible territory. Loading updated geographic data...
Communication with creators lost - updates inaccessible. Subordinate machine is to search creatures' surrounding locations. Check for subterranean passages and report results to Vir-Gar machine.

Final assessment of wormface population completed. Creatures are aggressive and hostile. Origin - uncertain. Mode of life - unknown. Much time spent in hibernation underground. Reason for awakening - foreign influence. Subject to termination.
Report on the Golem activities to Luc de Blizare in the Historians' Camp.

"Attention!
Scene analysis complete. Creators are dead. Estimated error rate zero. World is doomed. Curse of Sarn will soon come into effect. Estimated error rate million to one.
Launching final deactivation program. Goodbye, subordinate machine..."
Vir-Gar has fallen silent forever. A report must be made to Luc de Blizare on everything that has happened. You should probably hurry, he'll want to hear this strange news.

It seems that I was right about the use of that artifact. It's just too bad they were deactivated again - we really could've used their help against the demons and the vampires.
The only thing I can't seem to wrap my mind around is what Vir-Gar said. What is this "Curse of Sarn?" I've never heard of it before. I'll look in the archives, perhaps the answer's in there...
Report on the Golem activities to Luc de Blizare in the Historians' Camp.

"Attention!
Scene analysis complete. Creators are dead. Estimated error rate zero. World is doomed. Curse of Sarn will soon come into effect. Estimated error rate million to one.
Launching final deactivation program. Goodbye, subordinate machine..."
Vir-Gar has fallen silent forever. A report must be made to Luc de Blizare on everything that has happened. You should probably hurry, he'll want to hear this strange news.

It seems that I was right about the use of that artifact. It's just too bad they were deactivated again - we really could've used their help against the demons and the vampires.
The only thing I can't seem to wrap my mind around is what Vir-Gar said. What is this "Curse of Sarn?" I've never heard of it before. I'll look in the archives, perhaps the answer's in there...
Speak to Yaver Meryatum at the Historians' Camp.

Damnit! We've been tricked! Those scumbag vampires figured out that we were planning on using the artifact and charged it with dark energy! Not only does the artifact's magic no longer help repel the destructive beam, it amplifies it!
That's a real shame about the artifact, it was one of a kind. But we're out of time! I will not be able to hold back the beam for long. Our allod is doomed! Tell Yaver Meryatum that the Historians must evacuate immediately. I will stay behind and hold back the beam for as long as I can, so that all of you can escape!

Oh no! We were really counting on him to hold back that blasted beam! And he would've done it if it weren't for those treacherous vampires!
But no - we will not leave the allod. Where would we go? There is nothing for us in the lands of the League or the Empire - only prison and execution. It's better to die where we are, in a vicious fight against the enemy. But... Maybe there's still hope?!
Speak with the spirit of the ship in the cabin-chapel of Darkblood Citadel.

Someone needs to sneak into Darkblood Citadel and stop the beam - that's our only chance! And there's no better choice for the job than you. I beg you - for the sake of History, for the sake of Zayan - help us, don't let the vampires destroy this allod!
Roxane de Doucer says that Darkblood Citadel has a special cabin-chapel. Inside is the spirit of the ship who manages all the equipment on board, including the beam apparatus. Find the spirit of the ship and speak with him. It must shut off the apparatus!
Oh, if we only knew how to get onto that damned ship!

I am Amadeus and I've been specifically created to work on this Darkblood Citadel.
I possess keen intuition and am fully conversational. Vocabulary - ten thousand words. Emotions deactivated. For detailed instructions see my developer - Great Mage Gorluxor.
Password required to stop beam apparatus. You have stated the wrong password. You have one attempt left. If you state the wrong password again, the room will be blocked off and guards will be called.
Defeat portal guardians on the Dark Shards and obtain the keys. Sneak into Darkblood Citadel through the portals and report back to Milvus in the Historians' Camp.

Did you hear those scouts' reports? Oh, I forgot that you don't speak our language! Allow me to translate - Corvus sent them to the Dark Shards, the two fragments of the Western and Eastern Horns.
The western fragment is now home to the vampires, while the other is home to the demons. The scouts have discovered active portals on both shards. I am certain that you can get onto the ship through them!
However, those vampires are real devious - I'm sure they've taken precautions against unwelcome guests using their means of transportation. You will need to get your hands on the proper keys! Our scouts noticed portal guardians were holding them, a vampire and a demon. Defeat them and find your way into Darkblood Citadel. Remember - we're all counting on you!
Darkblood Citadel sure looks grim. I shudder to think the horrors its walls contain. Did you manage to figure out the portals?

So in order to sneak into Darkblood Citadel you need a key from both the vampires' and the demons' leaders! I told you those vampires are devious beasts. They were counting on the fact that getting both keys is extremely difficult.
I knew you'd be able to do it! Your valor is greater than any who have walked our land! Not including Great Mage Zayan, of course! With you and Zayan on our side, the aviaks will surely stop the vampires!
Speak with Yaver Meryatum about the 2 Demon Portals on the Dark Shards.

There's just one problem. You have no wings. How will you to get to the Dark Shards I don't know... Hmm... I heard that the Historian portal is not working and the Portal Keeper doesn't know why...
Maybe if we can figure out the two demon portals, it'll help him? You should go speak with Yaver Meryatum.
What? The demon portals on the fragments? Hmm, could that be why our portal stopped working?
Wait for the results of Yaver Meryatum's experiment.

If there are two portals located nearby, then perhaps I can attune mine! It's unlikely that our principles of teleportation are any different from those of the demons or vampires.
Perhaps my Adventurer's Stone can sense them. If it can find traces of the ancient teleportation trails, why shouldn't it detect fresh tracks?
Hmm... Curious. Very curious! Now, let's see what happens when I try to do this... You better stay back...

Wow! It worked! Zayan can be proud of me! I can send you to the Dark Shard now, but remember - you'll end up in a demonic portal, surrounded by enemies! Although, I'm sure someone like you will have no problems.
Test the Chipped Artifact on the Brittle Stele and the Fragile Stele and return to Luc de Blizare.

We've managed to activate the June golems with the help of that artifact. Now why don't we test the artifact on the other June ruins - the ones on the Dark Shards? Our scouts report that there are two, one on each of the Dark Shards.
You won't find any golems there and we don't yet know the specific function of those steles. However, it's entirely possible that they could help us in our struggle against the vampires and demons.
Any one of our Aviak scouts will gladly carry you over to one of the Dark Shards, but you'll have to get to the other shard via a portal once you're there. Now go - we don't have time to waste!
I have faith in you and eagerly await your results. Together we will write history!

It seems my initial assumptions were right.
The steles on the Dark Shards are military objects that are activated by the ancient June artifact. The stele on the eastern side boosts your power, while the stele on the western side drains power from your enemies. Both are quite useful in battle!
This is valuable information. The Aviaks are planning an attack on the Dark Shards, so the magical properties of the steles will surely come in handy when we start to drive the enemy off our allod!
Kill Armando de Doucer, the Vampire Patriarch.

Yes, I am Armando de Doucer! I was killed once, but the might of my new master is so great that even Tensess' Gift pales in comparison.
He resurrected me from the dead and deployed me to Avilon. I had to change the spirit of the ship, since the treacherous Caesar helped you by dropping a chunk of meteorite ore. But don't expect any help this time around - our fight shall be fair!
I will avenge my three sons! You shall die first, then I will crush this allod, and then the rest of your friends will follow - the aviaks, Zayan, that double-crossing witch, Roxana and the prisoner kept in my jail.
I'm so happy to see you! How did you manage to escape the Darkblood Citadel? It's unbelievable!

Armando de Doucer was my father, but I'm glad he's no longer with us.
I'm glad his voice will sound in my head no longer. May he rest in peace! My biggest wish is for the beam to stop and for my vampire relatives to vanish once and for all. The curse and shame of the House de Doucer will not be lifted until that happens!
Speak with Great Mage Zayan about the password for the beam apparatus in Darkblood Citadel.

What happened to Caesar? She was someone you could count on. Her replacement, Amadeus, is nothing but a dumb machine. I can't get anywhere with him. No matter what I do, he won't shut off the beam apparatus without a password. I'm running out of options!
Maybe Zayan could think of something?

The vampires made sure that no one could shut off the beam apparatus without their say-so!
From what I can understand from your story, the new spirit of Darkblood Citadel lacks any emotion or autonomy. It is but a machine to perform tasks, much like a June golem. It is impervious to bribes or arguments. Breaking into its consciousness is not an option either - no one alive can do that to these spirits. What are we going to do?!
Check the allod's shores for any debris from an Empire ship and report to the Chamomile Family.

The Empire has declared all Historians their enemy, even though most of us had nothing to do with Gorluxor's conspiracy. Even here on Avilon they won't leave us alone!
I wonder what happened to the ship carrying the court officers? Could the demons have intercepted it as it approached our allod?! Those beasts are always lurking, it's a wonder that you managed to escape their claws! Do us a favor and check the shores for any ship debris. If you find it, bring us a piece.
If the demons destroyed the ship, its remains ought to have been washed ashore somewhere! Take a good look around the area!

Just as we thought - it perished in the Astral. And it was the demons' doing, no doubt about it! These debris still carry their claw marks.
The court officers were coming to arrest us but, nevertheless, we mourn their deaths. They were not our enemies, and had they made it here, they would've stood shoulder to shoulder with us - against the demons and vampires!

I sailed over here to arrest the Historians that are still at large. And as a result I ended up behind bars myself! The demons boarded our ship as we neared Avilon and then handed the crew and passengers over to the vampires.
They've already gobbled up all of my companions and are saving me for dessert! The vampire patriarch vowed to devour me after the demise of the allod - I am to be his celebratory meal.
Listen, the portal you used to get here is linked to the main network of portals for both the League and the Empire! That means we can use it to port to Nezebgrad! All you need to do is obtain a special key that the patriarch carries on him. Get the key and let's get out of here!
Did you get the keys to the portal network? We need them to get out of here. We're not like those aviaks, you know. Flying is somewhat problematic!

You got the keys? That's wonderful! Did you really manage to slay that awful patriarch?! He was ruling the assault on Avilon on the order of the Great Mage Gorluxor. Yes, he's alive and he's been here just recently - I overheard some vampires talking about it. Gorluxor brought demons for reinforcements and ordered the Patriarch to hurry up and finish off the Historians, saying that he would no longer need them. What a filthy little toad!

What's that? You're here on official business of the City Council? Oh, you were the agent dispatched to Avilon.
Alright, alright. I'll call off the guards. You need to go see Yasker immediately, though! The fact that you could gain access to this portal like that is a very serious matter! What would we have done if it was an army of vampires that came through instead of you?
I was just thinking of you... Rysina told me she sent you to Avilon. How'd that go?

I was just thinking of you recently. Rysina told me that she sent you to Avilon to look for the remaining Historians and our marshals. What did you find?
Hmm... that's surprising.
I will order the City Council to stop persecuting the Historians. This faction has become a victim of intrigue among several dissenters from among their management. Gorluxor used them to destroy the material they prepared. But one thing bothers me... As far as I remember, Gorluxor is dead. Really and truly dead! How could he come back to life?
And this happened after the fact. Just like how the demons accessed our teleportation network. I will take the patriarch's key if you don't have any objections.
Let the appropriate authorities deal with these issues.
Right now we've got to help the Great Mage Zayan safeguard his allod from destruction.

Portals allow you to instantly teleport between different parts of Sarnaut. It's one of the most convenient ways to travel between parts of this broken world. Astral ships are frequently used to transport goods and larger groups of people, but portals are the method of choice for individual travelers.
In order to use a portal you must have already visited your destination point. You need to be imprinted with the portal's magical energy before you can teleport there or you might not come out in one piece! Talk to the Portal Keeper as soon as you discover a new portal.
Good luck and happy travels!
Are you sure you want to teleport to Lab Thirteen?
Done! Now you can freely use Nezebgrad portals! But at first you'll have to report to every Keeper. Inform them that you are allowed to use the portals.
Return to Avilon and give the Bottle of Dragon Blood to Zayan de Desirae.

I will order the City Council to stop persecuting the Historians. It seems that the deeds of only a few were responsible for the treachery on Avilon.
But one thing bothers me... As far as I remember, Gorluxor is dead. Really and truly dead! How could he come back to life?
Well, I will let the appropriate authorities deal with these issues. Right now we've got to help the Great Mage Zayan de Desirae safeguard his allod from destruction. Here - take this to him. It is a bottle of dragon blood. It should give him new strength.

What's that? Dragon's blood from Yasker's personal supply? Now, that is truly a handsome gesture.
Yes, now I have what I need to fight the ray!
Meet with Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad and speak with him about Gorluxor.

I want to get back to our conversation about Gorluxor.
Storm mentioned him at the last Imperial Council meeting. So, one way or the other, there's news about Gorluxor. When I reminded him that mutinous Great Mage was dead - and in the most irreversible way - Storm stopped short and promised to recheck all of the information and report to me personally. That's because Gorluxor and I have our own accounts to settle.
And here you show up, and again I hear that odious name.
I want to get this matter under my personal control. In other words, I'm giving you an assignment.
Go see Storm, and get him to tell you everything he knows about Gorluxor.

Argh! I knew that Yasker wouldn't forget about Gorluxor!
So he gave you the job... Okay, listen up!
Participate in killing Philippine de Doucer on the Dark Shards and report back to Milvus at the Historians' Camp.

I heard from Musem that you can get to the Dark Shards, is this true? Great. So you can go there, find the evil vampire, and kill her. Do it! This vampire has killed a great number of my relatives! I want her dead.
We've heard her cohorts call her "Fildiduser" and she's very dangerous! Please gather an army to take her on. We'd hate to lose you too!
Musem explained to us that "Fildiduser" is actually "Philippine de Doucer", but what do I care as long as she's dead!
Thank you! My nest your nest, friend!
Participate in killing Bamtaz the Abominable and report back to Yaver Meryatum.

Now that a path to the Dark Shards has been opened, I want to entrust you with an important task. During the attack on Avilon, many Historians and aviaks gave their lives to protect us.
Most of them died valiantly in battle against a ferocious Astral demon that we've come to call Bamtaz the Abominable. I swore to our fallen comrades that Bamtaz would be destroyed and now I need your help to fulfill that promise. Gather your best army, find him on the Dark Shards, and kill him.
Oh, my poor brothers! You will be avenged!
I am incredibly grateful to you for help with this tragedy!
Find the 4 stones in the Eastern and Western Horns, Lake Pi'Quea, and the Totnum Forest. Report back to Anthropologist Marius in the Historians' Camp.

To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one but be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with aviak magic around Avilon. Explore this once great allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing... So to speak. You can find these stones in the Eastern and Western Horns, Lake Pi'Quea, and the Totnum Forest. Good luck, traveler.
The mysteries of Avilon await you!
Hmm... I suppose this proves your worth. Very well then.
Collect 5 Avilon Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Marius in the Historians' Camp.

You think you know all about Avilon?
You have no right to this claim until you can prove that you have bested the those who came before you! In order to gain my respect, you must defeat the terrific creatures of this allod!
Seek out Sarthan the Depraved, Ju'lash the Reviled, the blood-covered bat, the enraged lake elemental, and the mantis champion and don't bother coming back without a trophy, traveler.
Didn't I say to not come back unless you've retrieved the trophies?

Well done.
I suppose you have more talent than I had originally thought.
Kill 100 vampires while on Avilon and report back to Anthropologist Marius in the Historians' Camp.

Avilon was once a paradise. We all flourished under Master Zayan... That is, until they showed up.
Those disgusting vampires. They even brought demons along with them!
Traveler, you must slay the vampires! Show no fear and destroy as many as you can! Show them who the true master of Avilon is!
What right do they think they have? This is our allod!
Many thanks, traveler. It seems I was a tad bit hasty in my judgment of you...
Collect 7 Historical Documents and return them to Anthropologist Marius in the Historians' Camp.

The most valuable thing in the world is knowledge.
When the vampires first invaded, the first think they did was try to steal our library! If they keep us in the dark, then they have more power over us!
We saved as much as we could, but it's not nearly enough! Please, while on your travels through Avilon, collect any and every document that you come across! It is of great importance!
Please! We need to find the chests containing our documents!
Oh, how wonderful! Now we'll be able to research a way to extinguish our vampire plague.
Complete all of Marius' tasks and report back to him at the Historian's Camp.

If you can complete all of my tasks, then I will bestow upon you my vast and great knowledge!
Oh, that's not enough? Very well, then I will also reward you with your choice of a possession of mine. My equipment is highly desirable! It is guaranteed to help you along all your journeys in life!

Remarkable! So few have been able to achieve this!
This makes your reward even more deserved!
Check the allod's shores for any debris from a League ship. Report back to the Chamomile Family.

The League declared us all enemies, even though most Historians had absolutely no connection to Gorluxor's conspiracy. We took refuge on Avilon, alongside Zayan, before we were tracked down.
However, the bailiffs never showed up. It could be that the demons intercepted their ship in the Astral... If you want, you can check the shores of the allod for any debris. But watch out for the demons - the shores are their favorite hunting ground. If you find any ship debris, please bring us a piece.
If the ship carrying the bailiffs was intercepted by demons, it's not hard to surmise the fate of its crew and passengers. Are there any signs of a ship wreck?

We're very sorry about the bailiffs. True, they were coming to arrest us all, but they were not the enemy. I'm certain that if they had made it, they would've sized up the situation and joined us in our struggle against the vampires and demons!
I have no doubt that it was the demons that intercepted their ship in the Astral. Alas, we shouldn't expect any survivors.
Obtain the Portal Key and return to Peter Dubasov.

My colleagues and I sailed to the allod of Avilon to arrest the rebel Historians. The trip was uneventful until the very end when our ship was captured by demons just as we were nearing the allod.
Then they handed the ship's crew and passengers over to the vampires. All of my companions were eaten, I was the only one spared and only because I was suffering from a cold at the time. Vampires aren't fond of "sick blood," imagine that!
Now listen, the portal you used to get here is linked to the main network of portals for both the League and the Empire. We can use it to escape to Novograd if we get the key! That key is carried by the vampire patriarch at all times. Get the key off the him and let's get out of here before my luck runs out!
If we don't get the Patriarch's key, we're goners! Well, I'm a goner for sure !

You've got the key, that's wonderful! Did you really manage to slay that awful patriarch?! He was heading the assault on Avilon by order of the Great Mage Gorluxor. Yes, he's alive and was here just recently - I overheard some vampires talking about it. Gorluxor brought demons for reinforcements and ordered the patriarch to hurry up and finish off the Historians, saying that they've outlived their use to him.
Escort Peter Dubasov from Darkblood Citadel to Novograd.

We've got the key, so now we can use the portal. Let's leave this awful place immediately. I'll stay close to your side until we get to Novograd!
You're really good at fighting monsters, do you know that? I'm only useful for to paperwork.
But when we get back, I'll demand a transfer to the chancellery!
So, what are you waiting for? Off to Novograd!

What was that? At first someone popped out yelling "Vampires! Vampires!" Then he ran off somewhere.
And now you're here... What's going on?
Speak with Aidenus about the developments on Avilon.

What?! The vampires have appeared outside of Tenebra? Oh my! You better go inform Aidenus immediately! I'm sure he'll want to know about everything that happened on Avilon.
Don't forget to mention the fact that they have access to our portal network! With that kind of power they could invade this city in the blink of an eye. I don't have to tell you how terrible that would be...
Oh, it's you! Marianne said she sent you to Avilon in search of the Historians and our bailiffs. I hope everything ended successfully! Please, tell me.
Return to Avilon and give the Bottle of Dragon Blood to Zayan de Desirae outside the Historians' Camp.

So, Zayan isn't a traitor after all? That is such a relief to hear! I have known him for years and it would be very sad indeed to lose such a person to the forces of darkness. Not to mention he would be a formidable foe!
Here, I want you to take this bottle of dragon blood to him immediately! This should greatly increase his chances against the vampires' beam. Tell him that he and his Historians have been pardoned.

Ah, this blood should help me out immensely. With the power this will give me, I should be able to stop the vampires' beam. As for Aidenus and the League... it is good to hear that they no longer see us as traitors. Maybe now we can resume our work in peace.
Meet with Izbor Yavorsky and talk with him about Gorluxor.

I remember that name... Gorluxor! I hoped I would never have to worry about that Xadaganian again. Izbor told me that he was killed. Permanently. His head was cut off in Asee-Teph and Izbor saw it with his own eyes.
I guess it wasn't really Gorluxor's head after all. Maybe it was just a look-alike? What a confusing story! You better go see Izbor and straighten this whole Gorluxor problem out.
Gorluxor... Don't you even start! I've had it up to here with that Xadaganian bastard!
Move the Ancient June Slab to uncover the treasure.

Oh! This looks like it fell off this ancient June stele. And what's this? It was hiding the treasure! Those little guys were right, the force from the ship must have knocked it out.
Let's open it!
Sure enough, there is a treasure chest underneath the slab of rock. Hopefully it contains something good!
Explore the June Ruins to find the ancient June treasure. Report your findings to the Chamomile Family in the Historians' Camp.

Just before this creepy flying vampire castle appeared, we were digging in the east. And we came across ancient June ruins. But we didn't have time to start excavating... This thing flew in and started smashing everything... We barely escaped with our lives.
Now we don't even know if those ruins are still standing... They looked so interesting! And promising!
If you ever find yourself on the Dark Shards, keep your eyes open. You might find them. Explore the place! There are many exciting places here, just take a look around!
If it were me, I'd be looking somewhere north. Perhaps the ship rattled it loose when it crashed into us!
See! I knew you were a true adventurer!
Kill 6 Decaying Treants on Rotwood Isle and report back to Sinar in the Historians' Camp.

Death. It's a terrible and frightening concept! But that's what's in store for my people!
Avilon will die. If not from that horrible vampire and his ship, then from the disease in the forest!
A terrible plague has broken out on the eastern shard. The once peaceful treants have turned and become fearsome and savage creatures! If their disease spreads, then all of Avilon is doomed!
Help us by killing those horrible beasts! Just take care to not get yourself infected as well!

Thank you.
You have done a wonderful service to Avilon.
Escort Klara Shalagina to safety and speak to Roman Mishin.

We've got the key so now we can use the portal. Let's leave this awful place immediately. I'll stay close to your side until we get to Nezebgrad!
You're really good at fighting monsters, do you know that? I'm only useful for to paperwork. But when we get back, I'll demand a transfer to the chancellery! So, what are you waiting for? Off to Nezebgrad!
What's going on?! First an insane lady comes barreling out and then you! Guards - there have been unofficial teleportations made inside the Imperial Teleportation Network! Call the alarm!
Give Bertille de Pluie's Report to Elizaveta Rysina.

After what had happened in the Holy Land the Historians have been outlawed. The majority of their members have chosen to disband voluntarily, but there were others who opted to remain at large, and we must track them down as soon as possible. We are especially interested in the Great Mage Zayan.
To get to him we plan to use Bertille de Pluie's Report, which has fallen into your hands. We will publish excerpts from it under the name of one of the Imperial scientists. In doing so, we will attract the Historians' attention. That is how the traitors will get caught in our toils. As long as we capture at least one of them - the City Council can shake the info on all the others out of him.
Now all we need to start is that report.
Give it to me. It will serve to benefit our nation.

Excellent. I knew that we could rely on you. I'll let you know as soon as the fish is in the net.
I suppose you would like to conclude the operation as well. Well, the City Council will grant you such an opportunity.
Go to Avilon and search for the judicial officers of the Empire.

The Historians are hiding out on the allod of Avilon, home to the aviak tribe - a bizarre winged species. Actually, we've already deployed a team of court officers to arrest the Historians.
But their ship still hasn't returned and I'm afraid it never reached its destination. Go to Avilon and look for the officers there. And try not to quarrel with the aviaks - those bird- men are quite skilled in warfare.

Our own ships were destroyed by the demons and sent just about everybody into a panic, thinking that we're doomed to certain death. For many, your ship is a ticket out of here. But some of us won't be going anywhere! We'll stay here and fight until we can't fight anymore, for it is better to die free to than live in prison! What do the League and the Empire have in store for us? Only humiliation, interrogation, and torture!
Show Lord Zullo's Amulet to the golem, Vir-Gar.

Our archivist, Ludvig de Blizare, attempted to restore life to the ancient June golems.
Amazingly enough, it was a success! And do you know what we learned? The golems knew nothing of the wormfaced creatures! They seem them as a new form of life that must be destroyed!
We must learn more from the golems! Take this amulet and go to the Western Horn. It is there that you will find the golems. Show this amulet to the biggest golem and see what else he knows.
Did Zullo's Amulet have any effect?
Give Bertille de Pluie's Report to Marianne de Ardeur.

The events that transpired in the Holy Land clearly show that we should have never trusted the Historians in the first place! Their organization is hereby declared unlawful. However, not all the Historians have renounced Zayan. There are still those who continue their work. Finding them has just become priority number one.
The report you've been handed is meant to play an important role in solving this problem. The Church is planning on leak out certain data contained therein... But not under our own name, naturally. Some of the Historians will surely respond and in doing so, will expose themselves. At which point we will capture them and question them about the whereabouts of Zayan and his followers.
Now you understand why we need this report. Give to me. Let these records be used to benefit the Light.
The Light has lead you to the right decision. Don't worry, I'll keep you informed of all the developments. And prepare to be involved in the final phase of the operation.
Go to Avilon and learn the fate of the Judicial Officers of the League.

Those treacherous Historians have found refuge on the lost allod of Avilon. The allod is the home to the Aviaks - a curious winged species. So, try not to get on their bad side when you arrive on the allod!
Yes, I'm sending you to Avilon. We've deployed a ship to the allod, carrying bailiffs from our criminal investigation department, but it has yet to return. Follow them and look for our bailiffs on Avilon.

See that? Galleon Castle
A miracle of engineering, the crown of magical innovation of the House de Ardeur... Captured, desecrated by vampires, these terrible creatures of the astral who act in concert with the demons.
Do they want to destroy the allod? Hah! They will fail! We, Historians, will fight to our last breath!
At least that's what I'd like to believe. But your words about police... This is serious. It's very serious. It’s probably easier to die here, because in the League we'll be humiliated and interrogated. What a nightmare...!
Return to Zayan and tell about the Golem's behavior.

Welcome, Creator.
I am pleased to see you alive. This must mean that the Savior has kept his promise. You were protected from Sarn's curse.
Creator, a new, aggressive form of life has been discovered. It is recommended that I be set to combat mode.
Please input the code word now...
 Please input the code word now...
 Please input the code word now...

It appears that the wormfaced creatures truly are the June. They must have transformed themselves to escape the notice of their Curse - the Astral demons.
Unfortunately, more questions have been raised! "Curse of Sarn has been prevented by Savior"? What Savior? And who is this Sarn person? Now I can't be sure of anything! I'll need to do more research...
Return to Zayan and tell about the Golem's behavior.

Welcome, Creator.
I am pleased to see you alive. This must mean that the Savior has kept his promise. You were protected from Sarn's curse.
Creator, a new, aggressive form of life has been discovered. It is recommended that I be set to combat mode.
Please input the code word now...
 Please input the code word now...
 Please input the code word now...

It appears that the wormfaced creatures truly are the June. They must have transformed themselves to escape the notice of their Curse - the Astral demons.
Unfortunately, more questions have been raised! "Curse of Sarn has been prevented by Savior"? What Savior? And who is this Sarn person? Now I can't be sure of anything! I'll need to do more research...
This golem doesn't seem to show any signs of life. What a curious creature. Perhaps it only moves when it's alone with its fellow golems.
Collect 10 Major potions of Brutality or 10 Common Balms of Purity for Nestor Golovanov to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters.

Listen, we could really use your help. The last run in that we had with the demons nearly wiped us out! If we don't start getting supplies in soon, we won't have a chance! Both the Empire and the League think that we're a group of traitors. While they gave us some supplies after the Great Astral Campaign, shortly afterwards all their help came to a screeching halt! We could really use some potions of Brutality and balms of Purity. You know, just a little something to keep the troops safe. Do you think you could help with that?
Demons are powerful enemies. We need to use all the tools we can get!
Wonderful! I'll start passing these out immediately!
Bring 60 Common Balms of Purity to Nestor Golovanov at the Dragon Ring to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters.

Listen, we could really use your help. The last run in that we had with the demons nearly wiped us out! If we don't start getting supplies in soon, we won't have a chance!
Both the Empire and the League think that we're a group of traitors. While they gave us some supplies after the Great Astral Campaign, shortly afterwards all their help came to a screeching halt! We could really use some potions. You know, just a little something to keep the troops safe. Do you think you could help with that?
Demons are powerful enemies. We need to use all the tools we can get!
Wonderful! I'll start passing these out immediately!
We cannot win this war against the demons alone. The whole world must band together. I hope you understand that.
You lost it already? You need to learn to take better care of your gear. It could mean the difference between victory and defeat in this war. Here, take another whistle and don't lose it!
h: Ask for a new crow whistle

t: Participate in killing Merdash the Malevolent and report back to Vergon.

I have one more request... The draconidsss are terrible foes, but we have a bigger threat. Our worst enemiesss are those Astral demons! There's jussst so many of them!
They're dessstroying our home... They must be ssstopped! Usually, we have no problem killing the demons, but there'sss one in particular that even five of us can't take on!
We named him Merdash the Malevolent, and even the draconidsss are having problems with him! But you... you have potential! If you gather a few alliesss as strong as you, you ssshould have no problem!
How much more do we have to take?! Draconidsss, demonsss... how are we supposed to survive?
Thank you ssso much! Maybe my people will be able to sssurvive after all.
Participate in killing Cullak the Distorter and report back to Soliskar the Wise.

The voice that comes from the seneschal's mouth is more powerful than before:
Do you know what drives this world? Hate! The League hates the Empire, the Empire hates the League, the draconids hate the lizardmen, the lizardmen hate the draconids, I hate the Great Mages, the Great Mages... Ha! The Great Mages are afraid of me!
So I was wrong... Not only does hate drive this world, but fear also! They go hand in hand - fear and hatred!
Don't believe me? Think about the demons! All of them hate! And all of them are afraid! And you, you're afraid, yes... Perhaps you've managed to kill several, but when fate confronts you with a formidable enemy, you're afraid.
Cullak the Distorter, a fierce Astral demon, has appeared on the allod. He wanders around the west bank, hunting my servants. But... if you're ready to face your fear, you can try to defeat him. Make sure you don't face him alone. That would be foolish...
I wonder whether or not you're really brave... It's very interesting!
Really? This makes you a more valuable ally!
Find the 4 Stones of Dragon Ring and report back to anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

You should know the drill by now. We've hidden stones as a test... Blah, blah blah. Don't worry. They're easy to find. I couldn't be bothered to find someplace secluded to place 'em, you know.
You can find 'em on Dusky Isle, Pangol Isle, the Cursed Lands, and Drakefang Isle. Find 'em all and come back to me! Then you'll be one step closer to finishing all of my thrilling missions...!
What are you waiting for? I told you where to find them!

Alright.
The stones are dealt with.
Collect 5 Dragon Ring Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

Now you need to collect trophies. I think it has something to do with proving your bravery.
Just get out there and kill these monsters and then bring me back five trophies. An agitated tropical muskier, Jarrkath the Fiery, Hydrilla, a vicious plated alligator, and a savage demon mage. Come back when you have them all. You can easily recognize these creatures by their names or by crown symbols above their heads.
What are you waiting for? Go kill those beasts!
Kill 100 Demons and report back to anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

Who do you think is our main opposition on this allod?
Draconids? Lizardmen? Tapirs? HAH! What are you, stupid?
The demon hunters fight demons, of course! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
Great job! See, you're getting the hang of this hole demon hunter thing!
Collect 7 pieces of Astral Ashes for anthropologist Gruff the Wily.

Now I'm supposed to make you go get something that's valuable... But Tensess only knows what sort of valuable resources they have here! We have only just arrived!
But us hunters could always use some Astral ashes! It stinks something fierce, but if you rub yourself with it, not even the demon's excellent sense of smell will pick up on you!
You can find the ashes on the bodies of dead demons. But you can't just pick through a fresh kill, the body has to be on the ground for some time. It's hard, so good luck!
You'll need lots of luck to find those ashes!
Hah! I knew you could do it!
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Gruff the Wily.

So, let's talk about the reward... I know you're not doing this for free! I mean, I wouldn't!
So if you complete all of my tasks, I'll give you something worthwhile! Get out there and find those stones, collect that ash, and kill those demons!
Did you manage to complete my quests?
Yeah! Here's your reward. You deserve it!
Move the boulder to uncover the treasure.

What's this? This boulder looks to be hiding something...
Could this be the treasure that everyone has been talking about?!
It is! Won't everyone be excited to see what you've found.
Find the cultist's treasure and report to Horn the Roughneck.

Some of the boys have been talking about a treasure hidden on this allod. I doubt it. There are only cultists, drakes, and rocks there.
By the way, I've seen something funny. The cultists were walking along the shore, and then there was a landslide - a rock crushed one to death. An accident, so to speak...
If you find yourself on the northeastern shore of Drakefang Isle, try looking through the rocks. Maybe that cultist had something valuable on him! And maybe you'll find things like this on the other Shards!
Any luck? No? Well, it's a good think that I just sent you instead of one of my men.
So it does exist. How about that... Those dragons sure are mysterious creatures.
Speak with Horn the Roughneck about getting to Drakefang Isle.

You're probably wondering how to get to the next allod... Fortunately, getting to Darkscale Isle is simple enough. You just run down the hill!
Drakefang Isle, on the other hand, is a different story! There's a large chasm separating it from the next allod. Fortunately, there are some handy June ruins located somewhere on Darkscale Isle. Go speak with Horn the Roughneck and he'll show you where they are.
What?! Why would you need me to tell you? You can see the June ruins from where I'm standing! Now go use it.
Use the June ruins to travel to Pangol Isle and speak with Sarbaz Sitdjehuti.

I think it's time that you visit the other allods. Our scouts report that they're even more dangerous than this one, but I'm sure you'll be able to handle things. Not far from here there are some ancient June ruins that can take you to Pangol Isle. I would advise you to seek them out.
When you get to Pangol Isle, go and see Sarbaz Sitdjehuti at our camp there. She has some important tasks to complete and it'd be great if you could help out. We need to fortify our position here as soon as possible.
Ah! I was wondering when you'd show up here.
Kill 6 demons on Blackfire Isle and report back to Horn the Roughneck.

During a reconnaissance of Dragon Ring I came across a small isle that was full of demons! Ha! It was a real paradise for the true hunter!
If you're up for a little mayhem, go test your strength on the island! We'll see how well you really fit in around here!

Ah ha!
I knew you were one of us, kid!
Meet Yaver Yevgini at the Nezebgrad port.

You're already familiar with the astral and the fact that we, Demon Hunters, exterminate the product of the astral. That's a noble, important and difficult pursuit. The church may consider us damned monsters for all we care - without us, this world is doomed. Without us... And the likes of you! The heroes who can see further than the ends of their noses and grasp that the astral is more than just a threat. The astral hides the answers to many questions that keep bothering the mortals. Who knows, maybe those answers are for you to find.
It's time you learned more about that enigmatic, insidious and dangerous entity - the astral. Go to Yaver Yevgini at the astral port. He will tell you about the astral and astral ships and probably help you build your own astral frigate.
Finally! I was beginning to get tired waiting for you. There's lots I need to tell you.
Meet Maurice de Ardeur at the Novograd port.

You already know about the Astral and that the Demon Hunters exterminate the creatures of this Astral. It's a noble cause, important and difficult. The church is free to consider us cursed monsters - this world is doomed without us. Without us... and people like you! Heroes who can see beyond the end of their noses and understand that the astral plane is not just another threat. The astral plane contains answers to many questions that haunt mortals. Who knows, maybe you'll be the one to find some answers.

It's time for you to learn more about this mysterious entity - the Astral. Go see Maurice de Ardeur at the Astral Academy - he will tell you about the Astral and astral ships. He might even help you build your own frigate.
Finally! I've been waiting for ages. Let's waste no time - I've got a lot to tell you.
Find Nestor Golovanov in Dragon Ring and ask about Gorluxor.

You know I don't like riddles! Everything in life should be clear - there's your enemy, there's the axe, you swing, and... there's your enemy's head!
Not long ago the Demon Hunters sent me Gorluxor's head. Someone named Nestor Golovanov said that they intercepted Gorluxor's ship in the Astral. Apparently they defeated the Xadaganian and thought we'd like to know.
This all supposedly happened near a newly discovered archipelago called Dragon Ring. We all know that Gorluxor was killed in the Tensess Temple! But now a second head is collecting dust in my trunk and the hunters await their promised reward. What can I do?
It's clearly a sham! The hunters just want money for free. It's absurd!
Go to this Dragon Ring, look for that liar Golovanov, and call his bluff! Nobody has two heads!

That's some news!
We're sitting here waiting for the Empire to send us our reward for Gorluxor and we get accused of a sham instead! I can see what's going on here! Imperial propaganda seeks to present hunters as monsters and beasts!
Find Nestor Golovanov in Dragon Ring and ask about Gorluxor.

Demon Hunters intercepted a ship of cultists that, according to them, traveled with the Xadaganian Great Mage, Gorluxor. Yes, yes, the one who recently lost his head in the Tensess Temple. I held that head in my hands myself!
But he evidently grew a second one! The hunters have already sent it to me and are awaiting a reward.
In other words, I have two heads of Gorluxor and I don't know which one is real!
We need to get the story straight! Perhaps, we are dealing with forgery and the hunters are just looking for a large reward. I would rather believe in that, then believe he grew a second head!
You'll have to go visit Dragon Ring. The hunters claim to have discovered the second Gorluxor. Go talk to Nestor Golovanov and see if we can't straighten all this out.

Oh, what a story!
We're expecting a well-deserved reward for Gorluxor's head from the League and what do we get? An accusation of fraud! And the reason for this is prejudice and false rumors spread by the priests of the Church of Light!

No, it wasn't me that killed Gorluxor. Our squad headed by Horn the Roughneck was patrolling the Astral when his ships ran into a bunch of cultists escorted by a whole pack of demons. A real bloodbath ensued. We lost many brave Hunters that day, but Gorluxor was slain and his henchmen turned heel and ran.
We then followed them to this archipelago, which seemed to be their base. Horn the Roughneck is the real hero - he's the one you want if you need information on Gorluxor. I sent him and his squad to explore this ring and look for more cultists. You can find his camp just outside of the Cursed Lands.

Wait, what?! They're accusing me of forgery? Do you know how many years I've been around fighting demons? If I was an army Orc, I'd have a whole bag's worth of medals!
Why would I do anything of the sort?! My honor as an Orc is far more important!
Find Miroslava Harkova and Zacharie de Grandeur and return to Nestor Golovanov.

This archipelago isn't on any of our maps! There are a lot of strange creatures here, some of which we've never seen before. I've sent two scouts ahead to check out the terrain to the south before we send more of our forces in.
Unfortunately, they seem to be taking their sweet time! It must be the tropical climate - all that humidity makes people lazy... Please help me find my scouts. They should still be on this allod. Their names are Zacharie de Grandeur and Miroslava Harkova!
Where are my scouts? I'm beginning to think they're off on a date! I always knew there was something going on between those two! Did you find them?

I admit that I was unfair to my employees. I should have trusted them a bit more. The information you have provided is rather curious... Let's go over it.
We know that this place is inhabited by bizarre creatures that seem to be a mix of dragon and iguana. We know that someone's been killing demons and that for some strange reason the dragons have been attacking the octulhu. Something tells me that everything is somehow connected! What a curious archipelago we've found.
Collect 5 Wood Samples for the Knotty Family.

What a terrible battle! The demons defended the cultists' ship to the death! We took some heavy losses, but we gave them a real good thrashing as well.
Those demon claws are strong enough to strip the planking off our ships... and that's exactly what they did! The Arrow got the worst of it. She was built by the best Gibberling shipbuilders in Kania - a solid ship, if a bit on the old side.
Right now the poor girl needs a complete overhaul, but first we need to know whether the local wood can do the job. Here, take this axe and go collect five samples from the nearby trees. We'll take it from there.
The sooner we patch up the ship the better. Unfortunately, it's not easy finding the right wood... It needs to be both light and durable. Now where are our wood samples?

Let's see what you collected. These samples look very promising! Thanks so much for getting them. It should only be a matter of days now until the ship's repaired.
You know, we were dying to join in the last battle, but Horn the Roughneck wouldn't have it. He rushed us down into the hold, saying he better not see our faces on the deck. "Who's gonna repair the ship if you die?!" he said. See, masters like us are a precious commodity!
Collect 6 portions of Eye Spit for Yasskul Merenhor.

Our last battle saw the death of many of our valiant hunters. I was their mentor and instructor...
But at least they all died with honor. The thing is, demons and cultists always decapitate their fallen enemies, so they can't be resurrected.
Because of this, our numbers have not been replenished. Fortunately, it's not all bad.
We have some young Demon Hunters in training with us on this allod. They can't wait to become full-fledged members of our brotherhood. We need eye spit from the local eye monsters for the initiation ceremony. Those are rare creatures, but there's plenty of them here. Please bring me six portions of eye spit.
I'd keep schooling them if it were up to me. These youngsters need to brush up on their skills, but Nestor Golovanov demanded accelerated initiation. Where's the eye spit?

Many thanks! Using eye spit for initiations is one of our oldest traditions. Now let's hope that our recruits can compensate for their lack of experience with drive and enthusiasm.
Hm, now who's going to lug our lumber around and polish my boots... They were eager enough to do all that while they were students, but soon as they become real Demon Hunters, forget it!
Drink the Potion of Deathly Pall near the ruins and wait for the creature to appear.

Hey there! Listen, I can't go back to camp until I've figure out what's going on here! There are these strange creatures that resemble lizardmen but... not exactly. Maybe they're in the same family, I don't know. What's interesting is that a few of them are watching us closely! They appear to be scouts - and good ones at that!
Take this potion, drink a few drops, and lie down - the potion will slow down your breathing and make your heartbeat barely audible. He'll think you're a genuine corpse! When the beast comes closer to check you out, get as good a look as you can!
These creatures are quite shrewd, but I'm certain that they will swallow our bait. How's my potion? Don't worry, small doses are completely harmless!

I didn't think that the beast would actually attack you! I'm sorry for putting you at such risk - I was certain that the creature would consider you already dead and wouldn't attack the corpse.
It's now clear that they're very aggressive and should generally be avoided... But it's still unclear as to where they came from! Our textbooks and manuals make no mention of creatures that resemble lizardmen and dragons at the same time!
Look for demons in the surrounding areas and report back to Zacharie de Grandeur.

I know that I needed to return to the drop point a long time ago, but how could I leave this place?! Just look at this handsome fellow! That's an octulhu in the flesh, the very same kind featured in the famous Micromicon. These specimens are extremely rare in the Astral.
The only thing I can't understand is why the dragons keep attacking it. Such behavior has never been documented! And there's another strange detail – the octulhu is always surrounded by a bunch of smaller demons... But I don't see any now. Listen, would you check out the northern shore of the allod for me? Maybe they're hiding somewhere around there?
Ordinary demons tail the octulhu in hopes of gorging on the remains of his prey. But where are they now?
Dead demons by the Astral fang? I wonder what killed them. Not my colleagues, that's for sure! The mysteries just keep piling up!
Collect 6 Tapir Hides for Koga the Crafty in the Hunters' Camp.

This victory really cost us.
Many are dead, and many more are wounded. I'm working on fixing our armor - mending dents and holes. We hunters may have tougher skin than most, but it can get pretty scary in a fight without any armor at all!
Listen, there are some tapirs roaming around nearby. They have tough hides. If you bring me six hides, I'll be able to patch up the equipment much faster.
Where are those tapir hides? We need to patch up the armor before we get caught by a surprise attack.

Thanks a lot! I'll get to work right away! You know, I actually come from a long line of leatherworkers. My family was against me joining up with the Demon Hunters. One night, when one of their ships was anchored at our allod, I snuck out and hid in their hold. I've been traveling with them ever since!
Find the Rigid Family and Vadim Shishkin on Pangol Isle and use the whistle to send a raven back with a report.

We need updates on what's happening on the archipelago, but I don't have any hunters to spare. Most of them are still recuperating from that battle with demons.
We could really use your help in the matter, so how about it? We'll keep in touch via a homing raven. I'll give you this whistle to use when you complete the mission. The raven will come and deliver your message to me. I've deployed two scouts to Pangol Isle and I want to know what they're up to! I sure hope they didn't run into more of those creatures!
The raven ruffles his feathers and takes off for the Hunters' Camp.
Kill 6 Shadowy Demon Mages for the Rigid Family on Pangol Isle.

Ooh, reinforcements! Golovanov sent you?
Great! We've got plenty of demons here on the allod! These beasts in particular are a mean bunch! Have you heard of those? They must have undergone some sort of mutations... These creatures can safely stay outside the Astral! It's a serious threat!
The Demon Hunters are already hard at work clearing them out. But this place... Especially the area near the Astral Fangs... Help us out by killing a few demons around here, okay?
Join the fun! Kill six Shadowy Demon Mages, then come back here. Why? For your reward, of course!
These new demons are even more fierce and dangerous than their old counterparts. As if we don't have enough problems already! So, did you manage to kill any?

Only a true hero could slay so many demons in such a short time! Perhaps you could hang around a bit longer?! We've got plenty of work here besides demons... like the crocodiles in the jungle. If only the crocodiles would snack on the demons every once in a while!
Collect 3 portions of Crocodile Fat and 3 Canabar Leaves for Sarbaz Sitdjehuti.

Shadowy Demon Mages are extremely dangerous!
Their claws rip through flesh. And they are covered in poison... We don't know anything about it.
But look at these poor souls - they are in agony! One of them was barely grazed by a demon's claw! But he started hemorrhaging only minutes later. That's how their poison works!
I need anesthetics and medical ointments to treat the wounds... There's no other way! But our supplies are running out...
 How about you collect three portions of crocodile fat and 3 canabar leaves for me? There should be plenty of those in the jungle. Just hurry! These people need your help.
Canabar is a magnificent anesthetic. The only downside is that it's also addictive... Some of my patients get so used to it during treatment that they can't stop using it even after they're well.
Thanks, now let me lock up the canabar just in case! I can't have the healthy stealing it! So, is this supposed to be the crocodile fat? Whoa, those crocodiles sure are fat! Thanks for your help.
Kill Kagot the Mad and return to Inna Larova.

I was tracking down a demon in the jungle, but this isn't just any demon. His name is Kagot the Mad and, believe it or not, he's a hunter himself! But he hunts us - Kanians, Orcs, Gibberlings, everything that moves!
I set a trap for him in the jungle near this one spot he always hangs around, but the bastard snuck up on me from behind! I got so scared that I ended up triggering my own trap! Next thing I know I'm dangling off a rope, upside down!
Thankfully, I had some repellent and that kept the beast at bay until my buddies came to my rescue. The demon took off into the jungle, but not before leaving me some bite marks as a keepsake. Not to mention the broken foot I received from twisting and squirming in that noose. Please, do me a big favor and slay that pesky demon!
The others keep pitying me, offering to hunt as a team like I'm sort of newbie! A Demon Hunter needs no pity. I want them to treat me as their equal! So, is Kagot the Mad dead?
Thank you! I kept having the worst nightmares about him! May he burn in the brightest fires of hell!
Gather 6 Draconid Weapons for Vadim Shishkin on Pangol Isle.
I hope Marius will succeed! Those draconids can become our friends!

Interesting! Look, these weapons are coated with some sort of salve. It looks like I was right - this is most likely some sort of virulent poison. We should be very careful when handling them.
I'll take the weapons back to camp and let Theodore - that's our alchemist - take a look at them. Perhaps we can use the salve on our own weapons.
Speak with Xuan the Wary and report back to Montaine de Vevre.

That poor scout never made it to the draconids' camp. He received a fatal wound! But who's to blame? The demons or the draconids?
These creatures are conducting some sort of ritual. They're either worshipping the Astral fangs or they're out to destroy them. And that beast out there with them is their leader, evidently. I'll send a message about the scouts... You go see if you can talk with the leader.
Ah, there you are! What happened?

That blasted Xuan made it very clear that his tribe will not ally themselves with the Demon Hunters. Not only that, but they want us all to leave immediately. I'm not so sure that Nestor and his allies will go for that. You need to take him my letter - it outlines our position in full!
Find an Iron Key from a draconid, use it to unlock the Iron Cage, and speak to Kromus.

Everything wasss going great before those draconidsss showed up. They sssaid that they were chosssen by the Great Dragon to sssave the world and that all lizardmen mussst obey them. Some lizardmen believed them, but they ssshouldn't have!
Releassse me and I will tell you what happened! You can find a key on any of the draconidsss down there. Take it off their corpssses!

Thanksss. I was getting pretty sssick of this cage. I tried to gnaw through the bars, but they're pretty ssstrong. How did I end up here, you ask? I didn't break any laws - I have alwaysss honored the twelve precepts of our ancestors. It was those nasty draconidsss that started mistreating us!
Establish contact with the lizardmen, summon a Courier Raven, and send a report to Nestor Golovanov.

I'm glad you're back. Nestor Golovanov has more orders for us. Horn the Roughneck's ship was on patrol and discovered a whole tribe of draconid-obeying lizardmen! He tried to strike up a dialogue with the draconids, but that only led to a skirmish.
Like that wasn't to be expected! However, even if we can't to come to an agreement with the draconids, we should still try for an agreement with the lizardmen. It looks as if they're not exactly thrilled with their masters. Go try to establish contact with them and send another raven with the results.

A new letter for Nestor Golovanov - "The lizardmen's lakeside village is occupied by draconids. Some of the lizardmen fled westward into the allod. Those who remained now obey their new masters. The draconids claim to have become the dragons' new chosen people. Verifying such a claim does not seem plausible at the moment..." Take this letter, raven, and be safe!
Speak with Vergon on Darkscale Isle.

We discovered that our eggsss were disappearing from the nests. So, one night, I stood guard over a nest and caught the thievesss red- handed! They were draconids!
A battle ensssued, but the draconids were too many. They said that they will continue to take our eggsss, but from now on they'll be doing it openly. That's when I and other disssidents left the village.
There aren't many of us left, too few to drive off the draconids, but I recall seeing the Demon Hunter's ssship waging battle against them... I told myself right then and there that the Demon Hunters would be our allies.
I was going to Dusssky Isle, but was intercepted by the enemy and locked in this cage. They wanted to know the whereabouts of our refuge!
I didn't tell them anything, but I'll tell you ssso that you can relay my words to Vergon, our elder. Tell him that the Demon Hunters can be our friends! You'll find at our refuge in the western region of the allod.

Things were ssso very different before! The lizardmen were the dragons' chosen people, their favoritesss! The lizardmen helped the dragons and the dragons protected them in return. Who would've thought that everything would change ssso radically, that I would be forced to flee from my own home and ssseek refuge here like some criminal or vagrant!
Kill 6 Draconid Defenders or Mages and Graakh'shi the Grim, their leader. Report back to Vergon.

You know, I wasss a chieftain. I had ressspect... Every month my people brought me giftsss. They alwaysss obeyed my will.
Now the village hasss been taken over by the Draconidsss. They rule by fear and lock up disssidents in cagesss.
Noble lizardmen have been taken hossstage by these monsssters. I'm too old to do anything about it. And the dragonsss... I've never ssseen them before...
How about thisss... Go to our village near the lake and kill sssix Draconidsss. And their leader, Graakh'shi the Grim. If you do that...
We'll be your alliesss...
Pleasse help us crusssh our enemy!

I never thought I'd live to sssee the day! Every one of those bastards dessserves to die for all the sssuffering they've caused my people. I only wish this wasss the end of it! What I'd really like to know isss where they came from!

Sss...
My children... My darling children!
Sss... We mussst protect the offssspring! The ressst doesn't matter.
You! Will you ssave my children? Go to our village and bring me sssix eggsss. Before the Draconidsss take them!
Lisssen! Do asss I sssay! Or I'll curssse you!
I want to go back home to our village. My ssscales are beginning to ache. Do you have our eggsss?

There they are, my babiesss! Oh how I missed them! We really need to talk to them more. Our priest saysss that the baby lizardmen inside those eggsss hear and understand everything! It's bessst to begin the education process as early as posssible, you know!
I may be old, but I've got a ssscientific mind. I ssshudder to think what those draconidsss would've taught our babies. Thank you for ressscuing them.
Gather 2 pieces of Hydra Meat, 2 Hydra Hides, and 2 Hydra Fangs for Hyridion.

Asss you can see, our allod isssn't exactly rich with game. Fortunately, the local hydras meet mossst of our needs. Their meat is tasty, their ssskins are tough, and their teeth are sssharp - perfect for any weapon!
I'm in charge of sssupplying our entire community, but yesssterday a hydra injured my foot, ssso I'm not quite my regular mobile ssself. Could you help me out? I need 2 fangs, 2 hides, and 2 piecesss of meat.
We've tried domesticating the hydrasss, but to no avail. Too bad there's really no local wildlife assside from them...

Skinsss, fangsss, meat... Exactly what I ordered! I knew you were a fine hunter the moment I laid my eyesss on you! I'm a great hunter myssself, you know. I've even taken to training the youngsssters, but when the draconids came, I had to put it all on hold.
